name: unwrangle_product
description: Product detail from a retailer (Amazon/Target/Best Buy/Home Depot/Walmart/…). Returns title, brand, price, rating, availability. Pass the product `url` (works for any retailer), or for Amazon pass `id`/`asin`. Example: unwrangle_product({ retailer: "amazon", url: "https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07ZPKN6YR", _apiKey: "your-key" })

retailer.description: Retailer slug that selects the platform, e.g. "amazon", "walmart", "target", "bestbuy", "homedepot", "lowes", "wayfair", "costco", "samsclub", "chewy", "tesco", "currys". Defaults to "amazon".

url.description: Product page URL (recommended — works across all retailers).

id.description: Product id (Amazon ASIN) — alternative to url. Amazon: pair with country_code.

country_code.description: Optional 2-letter country code (e.g. "us", "uk"). Defaults to "us" when using an id/asin.

_apiKey.description: Unwrangle API key (get one at unwrangle.com — $10 / 10k credits).

name: unwrangle_reviews
description: Reviews for a product on a retailer (Amazon/Target/Best Buy/…). Returns reviewer name, rating, title, text, date, verified-purchase flag. Pass the product `url` (or Amazon `id`/`asin`) and optional `page`. Reviews cost more credits than product/search. Example: unwrangle_reviews({ retailer: "amazon", url: "https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07ZPKN6YR", page: 1, _apiKey: "your-key" })

retailer.description: Retailer slug that selects the platform, e.g. "amazon", "walmart", "target", "bestbuy", "homedepot", "lowes", "wayfair", "costco", "samsclub", "chewy", "tesco", "currys". Defaults to "amazon".

url.description: Product page URL to fetch reviews for (recommended).

id.description: Product id (Amazon ASIN) — alternative to url.

name: unwrangle_search
description: Search a retailer (Amazon/Target/Best Buy/Home Depot/…) by keyword. Returns product name, brand, price, rating, url, id. Example: unwrangle_search({ retailer: "amazon", search: "wireless earbuds", page: 1, _apiKey: "your-key" })

retailer.description: Retailer slug that selects the platform, e.g. "amazon", "walmart", "target", "bestbuy", "homedepot", "lowes", "wayfair", "costco", "samsclub", "chewy", "tesco", "currys". Defaults to "amazon".
